title.en: An Act Declaring September 7 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the City of Cavite, Province of Cavite, in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring September 7 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the City of Cavite, Province of Cavite, in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 7 tháng 9 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Thành phố Cavite, Tỉnh Cavite, nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 7 กันยายนของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในเมือง Cavite จังหวัด Cavite เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 7 September setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Kota Cavite, Provinsi Cavite, dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 7 September setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Bandar Cavite, Wilayah Cavite, sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

text.en: September 7 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the City of Cavite, Province of Cavite, in commemoration of its founding anniversary.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
